_comment: PRODUCT-KITS-CONSISTENCY-001 — WebFlash-side vendored mirror of the canonical consumer bundle names owned by config/room-bundle-skus.json in sense360store/esphome-public. It exists so the WebFlash drift-guard (__tests__/kit-served-consistency.test.js) can assert that every VISIBLE kit's display_name matches the canonical bundle name, offline, without reaching the upstream repo. This is a NAME source only — no version, channel, or firmware data lives here (those derive from the served manifest / expected-surface fixture). Keyed by the firmware config_string, which is the stable cross-repo join key. Only the currently-visible bundles are vendored; add a row here in the same PR that surfaces a new kit. The esphome-public product guide titles are aligned to these same names by PRODUCT-KITS-CONSISTENCY-001 N3, so a customer sees one product name across the guides and the flasher.
